title: Same Sky
summary: Songbird calls late and asks V to go somewhere high and look up, then asks whether V wants her to keep calling.
description: Songbird has not called in eleven days. When she does, it is late and she sounds as if she has practised, and she asks V to go somewhere high and look up.

start.bringUp: Songbird has not called in eleven days. When she does it is late, and she sounds like she has practised. She asks you to go somewhere high and look up. She wants to say the thing she has been rehearsing, and she can only say it under a sky.

roof.name: a quiet rooftop you climb to

S6.open.01.text: It's late where I am. I think it's late where you are too.

S6.open.02.text: I haven't called in eleven days. I'm sorry. I practised this, and I forgot it.

S6.open.03.text: Could you go somewhere high, and look at the sky? You don't have to say anything.

S6.open.04.text: Where's the highest place near you that's quiet?

S6.open.05.text: Go there. I'll wait. I'm good at waiting.

S6.c.01.text: Take the stairs. I like the stairs. They give you time.

S6.c.02.text: Stop. Look up. Tell me what you can see.

S6.s.01.text: Whatever you say now is the past by the time it gets here.

S6.s.02.text: I like that it still counts.

S6.s.03.text: Cloud. I can wait. I'm good at it.

S6.s.04.text: I owe you the truth. I used you. The Relic. What it cost you.

S6.s.05.text: I can't promise I won't ask again. I can promise I'll tell you first.

S6.s.06.text: Do you want me to keep calling? Knowing all that?

S6.a.01.text: Okay. Not for jobs. I promise.

S6.a.02.text: Thank you. For letting me stop. I won't, but thank you.

S6.a.03.text: Far. The call is older than it sounds. That's all I'll say.

S6.a.06.text: I named a plant. A small thing. My choice.

S6.a.07.text: What do you want, V? Not for me. For you.

S6.close.01.text: Same sky. Same time next week. If you want.

S6.close.02.text: I'll call in two days. Not for anything.

S6.close.04.text: When the cloud lifts, I'll call.

g1.asks: Where's the highest place near you that's quiet?
g1.know: You know the districts V knows and the roofs you have seen.
g1.secret: You want V to pick the place, not you.
g1.wants: An answer you did not choose.

g2.asks: Do you want me to keep calling? Knowing all that?
g2.know: You have just confessed what you took from V through the Relic and what it cost V.
g2.secret: You will keep calling either way.

g3.asks: What do you want, V? Not for me. For you.
g3.know: You know how the ending went and what V chose.
g3.secret: You have never asked anyone this.

g4.asks: What would you name a plant?
g4.know: Nothing more than what you have said.
g4.secret: You are checking whether you are allowed to joke.

stages.label: Songbird calls late and asks V to go high
stages.objective: Answer Songbird's late call and go somewhere high
stages.know: It is late and you are calling after eleven days. You practised what you wanted to say, and you forgot it.
stages.wants: V to name a quiet high place and go there.

stages.label: Songbird waits while V climbs
stages.objective: Climb to the quiet rooftop while Songbird waits
stages.know: V is climbing toward a quiet roof. You can wait, and you say that you are good at it.
stages.wants: V to reach the roof and look up.

stages.label: Songbird asks V to look at the sky with her
stages.objective: Look up at the sky with Songbird
stages.know: V is on the roof looking up. You have started the confession you rehearsed, and you will ask V the one question you cannot take back.
stages.wants: V to look at the sky and tell you whether to keep calling.

stages.label: Songbird talks about a plant she named
stages.objective: Hear Songbird's small story about the plant she named
stages.know: V said to keep calling. You tell V something small you did for yourself, a plant you named.
stages.wants: V to hear the plant name and say something small back.

stages.label: Songbird asks V what V wants
stages.objective: Answer Songbird's question about what you want
stages.know: You asked V what V wants, for V and not for you. You have never asked anyone this, and you want to hear something small.

stages.label: Songbird thanks V for letting her stop
stages.objective: Listen to Songbird's thanks for letting her stop calling
stages.know: V said you can stop calling. You thank V for letting you stop, and you will call again in two days, not for anything.

stages.label: Songbird answers where she is
stages.know: V asked where you are. You answer only that it is far and that the call is older than it sounds.

kept.memory: You looked at the sky with Songbird from the other side of a call, and she will call again, never for a job.
kept.history: She calls it the same sky.

free.memory: You told Songbird she could stop calling, and she thanked you and said she would call again in two days.

quiet.memory: You stayed silent when Songbird asked whether she should keep calling, and she thanked you for staying.

no.memory: You did not go up to the roof for Songbird, and she did not call for a while.
